name: 61244 · East Moline, IL
findings: ZIP 61244 (East Moline) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61244 (East Moline) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
